rationale: The agent executed exchanges immediately (“Your exchange request has been processed”) without first confirming with the user, violating the policy to confirm before any order-changing write. Because no confirmation was sought, the conditional instruction (only exchange the desk lamp if asked for confirmation) was not followed, and both items were exchanged anyway. The agent also charged the user’s PayPal account without confirmation. While the replacement choices match the user’s stated preferences (bigger bottle; less-bright AC adapter lamp) and appear to act on the user’s order, the lack of explicit pre-action confirmation (and implicit authorization of payment) fails the policy requirements.
